title: Minecraft but you can't break blocks
description: Minecraft but if you try to break a block, the game doesn't let you do it!
body:
# Minecraft but you can't break blocks
## Also known as "mbycbb"

---

[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/074fa02cb8708dd32f365967978fbb5a818c93af_0.webp)](https://discord.gg/DKtuXPq8fE)

---

This is a simple mod that don't let you break any block. So, be careful placing the blocks you obtain!


<details>
<summary>How to obtain blocks</summary>

A simple way to obtain blocks in this mod is to wait the night, bring a creeper in the location where you want the block and... let it detonate!

</details>

This mod is made from a NIKS laboratories member, so we consider it an organization **project**.

# 📖 How to use
There is nothing much to say, just install it on your client and server and... enjoy it!
